data.one_liner: Convert integer numbers to Arabic words up to 99 trillion.
data.what_it_does: This package provides a simple API to transform numeric values into their Arabic word representation. It supports numbers up to 99 trillion and is null‑safe.
use_when: You need to display numbers in Arabic words in a Flutter app.
You want a lightweight solution without external dependencies.
You need support for large numbers up to the trillions range.
avoid_when: You require localization for multiple languages beyond Arabic.
You need advanced formatting or pluralization rules.
You are building a production app that requires extensive testing and maintenance.
strengths: Supports very large numbers (up to 99 trillion).
weaknesses: No support for other languages or locales.
No unit tests or documentation beyond a basic README.
No advanced formatting options (e.g., gender, case).
data.setup_notes: Add dependency in pubspec and import the package.
